portfolio.heading: Mohammed El-Aouni
portfolio.footer: Summaries reflect the original self-described lab work; outcomes are not independently audited. Career worlds are future-path simulations.
portfolio.profile.title: Cybersecurity engineering student · ENSA Oujda
portfolio.profile.body: The original portfolio presents Mohammed El-Aouni as a cybersecurity engineering student at ENSA Oujda, Morocco, focused on security operations and hands-on cybersecurity labs.
portfolio.profile.detail: This starting hub represents his current studies and self-described work. The other ports are possible future career paths, not claimed experience.
portfolio.soc.title: Security operations · SIEM labs
portfolio.soc.body: Portfolio-described lab work includes Wazuh managers, decoders and detection rules; Splunk searches; Sysmon Windows event collection; MISP indicator enrichment; and TheHive incident-response workflows.
portfolio.soc.detail: These are summaries of self-described projects, not claims of verified production deployments or measured outcomes.
portfolio.redteam.title: Authorized lab simulations
portfolio.redteam.body: The source portfolio describes sandboxed practice with Nmap reconnaissance, Subfinder and Amass enumeration, OWASP-style web testing, and privilege-escalation exercises.
portfolio.redteam.detail: No client engagement or third-party testing authorization is claimed here; the descriptions are drawn from the original portfolio. Future-path challenges run offline and use fictional targets.
portfolio.research.title: Windows & Active Directory hardening
portfolio.research.body: Source-described research explores Group Policy baselines, LAPS, Kerberos security topics, SMB/RPC segmentation, and forwarding Sysmon telemetry into security monitoring.
portfolio.research.detail: Presented as portfolio lab work; no independently audited enterprise rollout is implied.
portfolio.contact.title: PFE internship conversations
portfolio.contact.body: Interested in discussing a Projet de Fin d'Études (PFE) internship? Use the linked GitHub or LinkedIn profile to ask Mohammed about current availability and cycle details.
portfolio.contact.detail: Older cycle dates from the original site are intentionally omitted. This page does not invent an email address, CV URL or current internship dates.
